lede: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#14 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Indianapolis Colts -9.1 with a fair total of 44.4, before any sportsbook number is consulted.
